description: A shell script for rewriting git revision history with various filters and options, including functions for commit manipulation, filtering, and ref updates.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message to standard error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps commit IDs to their rewritten counterparts or original if not rewritten.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Skips a commit by printing its mapped parents.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a commit only if the tree is non-empty.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Ensures non-empty author/committer identity and exports related variables.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Parses author and committer info from a commit and finishes their identities.
